استأمروا (form X)
# اِسْتَأْمَرُوا (istaʔmarū) /is.taʔ.ma.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَأْمَرَ (istaʔmara)
# اِسْتَأْمِرُوا (istaʔmirū) /is.taʔ.mi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَأْمَرَ (istaʔmara)
